heading: Meet Dr. Kenneth Gay
text: Dr. Kenneth Gay is a lifelong Hillsborough County resident and retired educator who dedicated 39 years to Hillsborough County Public Schools as a teacher, instructional leader, and assistant principal.

heading: Meet Dr. Kenneth Gay
text: He holds a Doctorate in Child and Youth Studies and has spent his career supporting teachers, strengthening schools, and helping students succeed.

heading: Meet Dr. Kenneth Gay
text: Today, Dr. Gay continues serving the community by mentoring new teachers, teaching student health and safety programs, and volunteering as a historical docent. As a parent of two HCPS graduates, he remains committed to strong schools and opportunities for every student.

heading: Strong Student Outcomes
text: Every student deserves the opportunity to succeed and reach their full potential. The focus is on improving academic performance and preparing students for life after graduation.

heading: Support for Educators
text: Strong schools start with strong educators who feel supported and respected. Teachers and staff should have what they need to succeed in the classroom.

heading: Safe & Orderly Schools
text: Students learn best in safe and structured environments where expectations are clear. Schools should maintain discipline and create a positive culture for students and teachers.

heading: A clear plan
text: With 39 years of experience in Hillsborough County Public Schools, Dr. Kenneth Gay understands what works and what needs to change. His priorities focus on improving student outcomes, supporting educators, and creating safe, well-managed schools for every family.
